# Field blocks for Saxony-Anhalt, Germany

Germany, Saxony-Anhalt field boundaries (2021, 2022, 2023) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Tourismus, Landwirtschaft und Forsten (MWL) Sachsen-Anhalt. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_st/latest/de_st.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_st/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: determination:datetime, crop:name_en, metrics:area, geometry, id, flik, crop:code, crop:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_st/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_st/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_st/collection.json
